headline: MediaTek lists 2027 internships for RF wreal models and analog/RF design automation
fact: On October 5, MediaTek listed Singapore internships for 2027 covering mixed-signal verification and design automation. The verification role assigns analog/RF macro models for system co-simulation, Verilog/wreal models of RF calibration engines and analog leaf cells, and RF-digital testbench templates. The automation role covers Python, EDA tools, data analysis and exploration of AI for simulation, layout, verification and design workflows. The listings establish advertised student work, not a newly deployed modeling or AI platform.
